reconstruction_levels.L2_external_inference_replay: Regenerate model outputs under the frozen provider, official-method adaptation and request budget.
reconstruction_levels.L3_public_clean_clone: Rebuild the claimed artifact from a licensed rights-safe recursive clone without private paths, local caches or credentials for the offline portion.

blocking_gaps: Ten of thirteen key experiment scripts are absent from Git tracking, including all inspected TSP, OR-Debug, external-summary and count-certificate entrypoints.
Eleven of sixteen headline groups lack a producer for the exact headline schema; several are manually assembled metadata or arithmetic audits.
No single top-level command defines dependency checks, immutable output locations, layer selection and expected hashes for the paper.
Rights-sensitive TSP text and OR-Debug repair objects require safe reconstruction projections before release.
The tracked offline requirements do not lock the provider transport, Gurobi/native execution environment or every upstream dependency.
The local upstream checkout and solver availability do not substitute for a credential-free recursive clean-clone run.
The external methods require dated provider access and, for CoE/BIND, disclosed official-code adapters; aggregation of stored results is not inference reproduction.
required_next_actions: Define a reviewed release allowlist for every producer, test and minimal dependency needed by the 16 headline groups.

decision.permitted_claim: The current workspace contains identifiable local reconstruction paths for several core results, but the public repository lacks most of their producers and has no end-to-end clean-clone command contract.
prohibited_claims: Every headline result can be regenerated from the current GitHub repository.
The targeted offline test record is a rerun of headline benchmark inference.
Stored BIND/CoE aggregation reproduces their model inference.
